description: This file contains functions for managing execution webhooks in a storage layer, including registration, retrieval, listing due webhooks, marking as in-flight, updating state, and checking webhook existence within a SQL database.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: A storage class encapsulating database operations related to execution webhooks.

methods.name: RegisterExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Stores or updates a webhook registration for a specific execution.

methods.name: GetExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Fetches the webhook registration details for a given execution ID.

methods.name: ListDueExecutionWebhooks
methods.description: Returns a list of webhooks that are due for delivery based on their status and schedule.

methods.name: TryMarkExecutionWebhookInFlight
methods.description: Atomically marks a webhook as in-flight/delivering, if it is pending and scheduled.

methods.name: UpdateExecutionWebhookState
methods.description: Updates the delivery state and other metadata of a webhook after an attempt.

methods.name: HasExecutionWebhook
methods.description: Checks if a webhook is registered for the specified execution ID.

methods.name: ListExecutionWebhooksRegistered
methods.description: Returns a map indicating which execution IDs have registered webhooks.
